About GODIA PRIME CONNECT — mission, vision and values

Our Vision & Mission

Our Vision

To become a trusted digital business network connecting people, businesses, and opportunities across Kenya and beyond.

Our Mission

To connect customers with businesses, link traders with reliable supply opportunities, and equip entrepreneurs with accessible digital tools to discover markets, manage business activities, and grow sustainably.

CONNECTIONBringing people and businesses together.
TRUSTEncouraging honest practices and clear information.
OPPORTUNITYHelping people discover markets, services, and jobs.

GROWTHSupporting entrepreneurs as they develop.

Universal Business POS & Inventory

One adaptable checkout and stock workspace for retail, supermarkets, wholesale, warehouses, hardware, pharmacies, restaurants, salons and service businesses.

UNIVERSAL POS

🏪 Set up this outlet

If your business is not listed, create a POS profile here. This does not create a public supplier listing. You can also choose a registered business below.

Choose the outlet whose sales you are recording. Stock is kept separately per outlet. A USB/Bluetooth barcode scanner that types into the field can be used; manual SKU/barcode/product-name search is also supported. Use a USB/Bluetooth barcode scanner or search by SKU, barcode, or product name.

🤖 GODIA SMART AI Business Tutor — POS Lessons

Quick beginner guide. This is built-in help content; a live AI tutoring service is not connected yet.

Lesson 1: Set up your products

Open Products, add the product name, selling price and unit. Enter a barcode or SKU if one exists. Save the product, then receive the quantity into the correct outlet's stock.

Lesson 2: Use a barcode scanner

Connect a compatible USB/Bluetooth scanner that types into the phone or computer field. Tap the Barcode / SKU field, scan the product, confirm the item and quantity, then add it to the sale. If scanning does not work, type the barcode, SKU or product name. A phone camera scanner requires a separately implemented and tested camera feature.

Lesson 3: Complete a sale

Select the correct outlet, scan or search each product, review quantities and prices, select the payment method, enter a customer/reference if needed, then complete the sale. Check the receipt and stock balance.

Lesson 4: Track stock and debts

Receive stock when goods arrive. Check low-stock alerts regularly. If a sale is on credit, enter the customer's name and use the debt list to track outstanding balances. Confirm actual payments before recording them as paid.

Lesson 5: Understand reports

Review recorded sales, expenses, stock movements and debts. Sales revenue is not the same as profit; deduct costs, refunds, delivery expenses and payment charges before estimating profit.

Ask GODIA support for POS training on WhatsApp

GODIA PRIME CONNECT Policies

Plain-language starting policies for marketplace, POS, payments, subscriptions and data.

POLICY DRAFT

1. Terms of Use

By using GODIA PRIME CONNECT SOLUTIONS, users agree to provide accurate account and business information, protect their login details, and use the platform lawfully. Users are responsible for listings, prices, stock information, product quality, and messages they submit. GODIA may restrict or suspend accounts for fraud, impersonation, abuse, unsafe listings, repeated violations, or legal requirements, subject to applicable law and a fair review process.

2. Privacy & Data Protection

GODIA should collect only information reasonably needed to operate accounts, connect buyers and suppliers, process orders, provide support, improve security, and meet legal obligations. Access to personal and business records should be limited by role. Do not submit passwords, M-Pesa PINs, card secrets, or another person's sensitive information in public listings or AI chats. Users may contact support to request access, correction, or deletion where applicable, subject to legitimate record-retention duties. Before public launch, publish the final data controller contact, retention periods, processors, and applicable data-subject request procedure.

3. GODIA SMART POS Trial & Subscription

The proposed starting offer is a 7-day free trial, KES 5 per day, KES 100 per month, or KES 1,000 per year. The final applicable price, plan duration, renewal terms, and any taxes or payment charges must be shown before the customer confirms payment. When a trial or paid period expires, paid POS functions may be restricted until payment is verified. Existing business records must be preserved and made available according to the published retention policy; subscription expiry must not silently delete customer data. Price changes should apply prospectively and be communicated before they affect a renewal.

4. Payments, Till & Refunds

Current support details: WhatsApp/phone 0703 183 586; M-Pesa Till 1692851. Customers should verify the payee and amount before paying. GODIA must not request a customer's M-Pesa PIN. A payment is treated as successful only after confirmation from the configured payment provider or a verified reconciliation process. Refund eligibility, timing, and contact steps must be shown clearly before checkout and handled in accordance with applicable Kenyan law and the specific transaction terms. Do not assume that a submitted screenshot or transaction code alone proves payment.

5. Marketplace, Orders & Delivery

Suppliers are responsible for lawful products, accurate stock and prices, truthful descriptions, and honoring confirmed orders. Customers should check quantities, delivery fees, delivery location, payment method, and total price before confirming. A price or stock change must not silently change an already-confirmed order; changes require agreement from the affected customer. GODIA may help resolve disputes but should not claim to guarantee a supplier's product or delivery unless a specific guarantee is explicitly offered in writing.

6. AI Tutor & Business Advice

GODIA SMART AI may explain app features and offer general business guidance, but its answers can be incomplete or mistaken. Users should verify important financial, legal, tax, stock, and safety decisions. AI must not approve payments, change owner settings, reveal private data, or make purchases on a user's behalf without an explicitly authorized and secured workflow. Tutorials must describe only features that are available and tested.

7. Acceptable Use, Security & Complaints

Do not use GODIA to scam, impersonate others, distribute unlawful goods, harass users, scrape private data, or bypass access controls. Report suspected fraud, account compromise, incorrect charges, or order disputes through WhatsApp support. GODIA should keep an auditable record of important account, payment, and administrative actions and restrict Owner tools to the authorized Owner account.

Important launch note: These are practical draft policies, not a lawyer's review or proof that the related backend controls are active. Before accepting live payments or onboarding the public, review them for Kenyan legal compliance and make sure the live app's data, subscription, payment, security and complaint-handling practices actually match the wording.
